description: The claim set the default_unwind capture actually covers. VO-11b compares a log with the manifest it was decided against, so a positive fixture must bind a manifest naming exactly the harnesses the log reports. It narrows the crate manifest rather than restating it: the roles, declared cover, and expected failure are the crate's, and only the selection is this record's.

harnesses.name: harnesses::verified
covers: the boundary below saturation is reachable
